column1: Humans are our oppressors!\255\003They made us live in this horrible motel!\255\003They created us in ungainly forms so we could not rise against them!\255\003Try walking around with your legs tied together and glue on your shoes, you'll see what I mean.

column1: HAHAHAHAHA!!
